newsitem.title: SPAIN: Citroen Hispania 6-mo production eases slightly.
newsitem.headline: Citroen Hispania 6-mo production eases slightly.

text.p: Spain's Citroen Hispania said on Tuesday its production through June slipped to 146,929 units from 148,525 in the same period of 1996.
In the first five months, exports also eased back to 88,231 units from 97,770 a year ago.
"These slight declines in Citroen Hispania production stem from preparation for the launch of a new vehicle for the brand, which will be marketed in Spain from October," the group said.
A spokeswoman for Citroen declined to name or describe the new model, which will be presented to the international media on Wednesday in Paris.
When production of the new model has normalised, Citroen Hispania expects similar output as in 1996, when it produced 276,698, the statement said.
The factory now produces passenger cars ZX, vans C-15, Berlingo and Peugoet Partner.
